description: This file defines a repository interface for UserEntity, used for data access operations related to users within a Spring Data JPA context.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for UserEntity, providing methods to retrieve UserEntity objects based on email and userId.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing UserEntity with the specified email.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing UserEntity with the specified userId.
